The AI layer is a 1,500,548-parameter multi-label neural network (2,560 hashed bag-of-tokens + 48 engineered features → 512 → 256 → 128 → 4 outputs) trained offline by distilling expert security heuristics into the network, then int8-quantized and embedded in this page. Inference runs 100% locally — no data leaves your browser. It complements, and does not replace, the rule-based findings.

⚠ Use this tool only on websites you own or have explicit permission to test. This is a passive, browser-side scanner — it fetches publicly reachable pages only and cannot replace a full penetration test.
